#!/bin/bash
# pre-push hook — 推送前检查 ~/.nanobot 配置仓库状态
# 安装到 nanobot-src/.git/hooks/pre-push

CONFIG_DIR="$HOME/.nanobot"

if [ ! -d "$CONFIG_DIR/.git" ]; then
    echo "⚠️  pre-push: $CONFIG_DIR 不是 git 仓库，跳过检查"
    exit 0
fi

cd "$CONFIG_DIR" || exit 1

# ── 检查 1：未提交变更（阻止） ──
UNSTAGED=$(git status --short)
if [ -n "$UNSTAGED" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "❌ 推送被阻止：配置仓库 ($CONFIG_DIR) 有未提交变更"
    echo "$UNSTAGED" | while IFS= read -r line; do echo "   $line"; done
    echo ""
    echo "请先提交或暂存这些变更，再重新推送。"
    echo "  cd $CONFIG_DIR && git add -A && git commit -m \"...\""
    exit 1
fi

# ── 检查 2：未推送 commit（警告） ──
UPSTREAM=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref @{u} 2>/dev/null)
if [ -n "$UPSTREAM" ]; then
    UNPUSHED=$(git log @{u}..HEAD --oneline 2>/dev/null)
    if [ -n "$UNPUSHED" ]; then
        COUNT=$(echo "$UNPUSHED" | wc -l)
        echo ""
        echo "⚠️  警告：配置仓库 ($CONFIG_DIR) 有 $COUNT 个未推送的 commit"
        echo "$UNPUSHED" | while IFS= read -r line; do echo "   $line"; done
        echo ""
        echo "建议：推送前先推送配置仓库的变更。"
        echo "  cd $CONFIG_DIR && git push"
        # 不阻止，仅警告
    fi
fi

exit 0

#!/bin/bash
# pre-push hook: 推送代码前检查配置仓库状态
CONFIG_REPO="/root/.nanobot"

# 检查配置仓库是否有未提交变更
if [[ -n $(git -C "$CONFIG_REPO" status --short 2>/dev/null) ]]; then
  echo "❌ 配置仓库 ($CONFIG_REPO) 有未提交变更："
  git -C "$CONFIG_REPO" status --short
  echo ""
  echo "请先提交配置仓库，再推送代码。"
  exit 1
fi

# 检查配置仓库是否有未推送的 commit（警告但不阻止）
UNPUSHED=$(git -C "$CONFIG_REPO" log @{u}..HEAD --oneline 2>/dev/null)
if [[ -n "$UNPUSHED" ]]; then
  echo "⚠️  配置仓库有未推送的 commit："
  echo "$UNPUSHED"
  echo ""
fi

exit 0
